title: Real Exponent Form of the Hypercontractive Condition
statement: Let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$ and $\rho\in\mathbb R$. If $1\le p\le q$, $q$ is finite, and $\rho^2(q-1)\le p-1$ in the extended nonnegative reals, then $\rho^2(q-1)\le p-1$ as an inequality of real numbers.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho^2(q-1)\le p-1$ in the extended nonnegative reals
